Home.metaDescription: Ship complex tasks in a crisp three-pane workbench—sessions, chat, artifacts together.
Home.heroBody: ash is a three-pane agent workbench: task list left, conversational orchestration in the center, Plan / toolchain / artifacts on the right. Vertical packs like knowledge work or creator workflows can dock later.
Home.whyTitle: More than chat—an inspectable Agent workflow
Home.whySubtitle: Task-centric like Manus-class products—planning, tooling, artifacts, and conversation all on one plane. Phase 1 already ships the full chrome.
Home.highlight1Body: Conversation rail, chat/input column, structured Plan/tool/artifact rails—collapse friendly and shortcut aware.
Home.highlight2Body: Thinking core runs in its own runtime; the web shells sessions and product UX with a crisp boundary.
Home.highlight3Body: Reserve hooks for vertical packs—the right workspace rail can pivot per feature toggle.
Home.showcaseSubtitle: Sample narratives illustrating information architecture—not live customer proofs.
Home.teaser1Copy: Structured outlines, competitive tables placeholders, citations-first flow.
Home.teaser2Copy: Weekly task lists plus draft artifact cards for multi-platform pipelines.
Home.teaser3Copy: Bring sheets, docs, and calendars onto the same workbench rails for approvals.
Home.docsCardBody: Engineers read ARCHITECTURE, ADRs, and component contracts; integrators onboard via quickstart chapters.
Home.pricingCardBody: Phase 1 shows placeholder tiers; GA pricing will tie seats / usage / private cloud.
Home.bottomBody: Load sample threads to explore Plan/trace/artifact interplay—swap in cogito later without ripping the UX.

Product.metaDescription: Three-pane topology, cogito-hosted execution, toolchain visibility, modular packs.
Product.title: ash: a deliberate web cockpit for Agent work
Product.subtitle: Phase 1 delivers the full frontend shell plus demo payloads; live runtime, quotas, and collaboration milestones follow separately. Narrative commitments here—not billing facts yet.
Product.pillar1Body: Fixed three rails—conversation roster, conversational spine, Plan/tool/artifact stacks aligned with serious task tooling.
Product.pillar2Body: Browsers never embed cores; cogito mounts server-side behind HTTP/SSE with a clear scalability path.
Product.pillar3Body: Calls stay inspectable—artifacts consolidate shareable outputs instead of drowning in transcripts.
Product.pillar4Body: Register vertical packs—knowledge suites, creators, etc.—without rewriting the chassis.
Product.pillar5Body: Multi-tenant, SSO, auditing, SLA are roadmap-but UI preserves space for tenant-grade navigation.
Product.pillar6Body: Manus palette plus DM Sans + Noto Sans SC—calm typography over chrome.
